reason: The bounded Twelve M1 history reader now executes the existing scheduled-capture and successful-bootstrap decision-admission predicates as set-based joins instead of invoking the correlated admission view for every candle. The admitted evidence set, revision policy, required M1 opens, timeframe construction, semantic identity, model inputs, safety gates, publication permissions and analogue permissions are unchanged.

bootstrap admission remains bound to succeeded bootstrap request, succeeded bootstrap window and candle open time inside the attested window
failed bootstrap windows remain excluded even if a partial persistence attempt wrote canonical candles
required M1 evidence set and newest immutable revision selection are unchanged
semantic identity, context composition, model gateway, safety gates, publication permissions and analogue permissions are unchanged
only bounded M1 query execution changes from correlated view evaluation to set-based equivalent provenance joins
